orgDesign.companyProfile: Hybrid industrial-water organization combining software, edge connectivity, remote operations, chemistry expertise, and field service.
orgDesign.operatingModel: Teams own reusable digital products and service workflows while field and remote experts execute through shared operational systems. The goal is to productize repeatable water outcomes, not to run every site as a custom project.
designPrinciples: Keep ownership clear between site-intelligence, water-performance, enterprise-value, and service-operations teams.
Use shared data and workflow products to scale expertise instead of expanding ad hoc manual service.
Tie team missions directly to customer and business KPIs, not only to internal platform outputs.
orgDesign.staffingPrinciple: Model total staffing around 250 FTE across delivery teams and group leadership; keep every delivery team at 6-10 FTE, with no individual team above 10 people.
orgDesign.groupingPrinciple: Group teams by durable product area so ownership of data, workflows, and outcomes stays understandable.
orgDesign.groupLeadershipPrinciple: Every group has explicit lightweight leadership: a Head of group, product and engineering directors, and principal/staff-plus IC coverage for architecture, product quality, and cross-team standards.
